About.hook: I don't want to just code. <hl>I want to build.</hl>
About.intro1: I'm Juan Diego, a student of Software Analysis and Development, and someone who learns best with a problem in front of them and something to build.
About.intro2: My path into software development has mostly come from curiosity. An idea can start as a simple question —“what if this could be done differently?”— and end up becoming an MVP, an app, a database, or a full system.
About.intro3: I'm especially drawn to projects that connect software with real-world problems: processes that can be automated, information that can be organized better, and tools that can make someone's work simpler.
About.intro4: That's why I'm not interested in learning a technology just to say I know it. I want to understand why it exists, when to use it, and how it fits into a bigger system.
About.intro5: Right now I'm strengthening my foundations in software development, databases, and application architecture. I'm also exploring how to go from small projects and MVPs to more complete, maintainable applications that can actually grow.

process.title: Imagine
process.description: It all starts with an idea. It doesn't matter if it's still incomplete.

process.title: Understand
process.description: I try to find out what problem actually exists and what the person using it needs.

process.title: Build
process.description: I turn the idea into something functional as soon as possible. A prototype that can be seen, tested, and questioned.

process.title: Iterate
process.description: I test it, find what's wrong, learn, and build it again.

About.closingQuote: Because to me, coding isn't just about writing code. It's about taking something that doesn't exist yet and turning it into something that can be used.
About.beyondParagraph: I want to keep learning, experiment with new technologies, and take on bigger projects. I want to reach the point where an idea doesn't just sit in a folder called final_project_v7_actually_final_final 💀, but turns into a real solution.
About.beyondClosing: This portfolio is part of that process.
About.beyondPullQuote: It doesn't represent everything I know. It represents everything I'm building toward knowing more.
